title: Data API paging: a negative $skip/offset answers 500, and a non-numeric or negative $top/limit is silently ignored
body:
QA-source: #25227 · api-backend.query-contract-matrix · observed beside the clauses

Found by an off-clause boundary probe during the 18.1.0 P0 run; re-measured on a second boot. Not a regression: the same coercion ships in the published `@objectstack/metadata-protocol@18.0.0`.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin bearer)

| request | answer | expected |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$skip=-5` | **500** `{"error":"Internal server error","code":"INTERNAL_ERROR"}` | 400 naming `$skip` |
| `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$skip=-1&$top=3` | **500** INTERNAL_ERROR | 400 |
| `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_account/query {"offset":-5}` | **500** INTERNAL_ERROR | 400 naming `offset` |
| `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$top=abc` | 200, all 14 rows (as if no `$top`) | 400 naming `$top` |
| `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$top=-1` | 200, all 14 rows | 400 |
| `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_account/query {"limit":-1}` | 200, all 14 rows | 400 |
| `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$top=` | 200, 0 rows (`Number('')` is 0) | 400, or treated as absent |
| `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_account/query {"limit":"ten"}` | 400 VALIDATION_FAILED `query.limit` | (correct — the two doors disagree) |

Server log on the 500s: `[REST] Unhandled error: Error: A non-negative integer must be provided to offset.` (knex `QueryBuilder.offset`, from driver-sql).

## Mechanism

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (the list-query normalizer, around the `[#3795]` slot fold) coerces with `options.limit = Number(options.limit)` and `options.offset = Number(options.offset)` and never range-checks: NaN reaches the driver and is dropped (the window is ignored), a negative limit is dropped the same way, and a negative offset reaches knex and throws. The query schema's `offset: z.number()` has no `.nonnegative()`, so the POST door passes a negative offset too.

This is the silent-coercion class of #7321 (`limit: NaN`): a malformed window answers as if no window was sent. The filter is never widened, only the page window.

## Suggested fix

Validate the coerced `limit`/`offset` (and their `$top`/`$skip`/`top` spellings) as non-negative integers on both doors and refuse otherwise with a 400 that names the parameter the caller wrote (the #4226 spelling discipline), plus a conformance test for `$skip=-1`, `$top=abc`, `$top=-1` and the empty `$top=`.
